issue.title: `array.tofile()` crashes due to use-after-free when `write()` callback modifies the array

labels.name: type-bug
labels.description: An unexpected behavior, bug, or error

labels.name: extension-modules
labels.description: C modules in the Modules dir

labels.name: pending
labels.description: The issue will be closed if no feedback is provided

comments.body:
Yes, this is a duplicate of #142884 — same root cause in `array_array_tofile_impl()`: `nbytes`/`nblocks` are cached once and never rechecked after `f.write()` executes arbitrary Python code.

I've opened a PR with a fix and regression tests: #144925

Closing this as duplicate.
